title: Pan-Seared Fish with Mediterranean Pilaf
description: A flavorful French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared fish served with a mediterranean pilaf.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
2. Season the fish fillet with salt and sugar.
3. Add olive oil to the pan and sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side.
4. Remove the fish from the pan and set aside.
5. Cook the Mediterranean pilaf mix according to package instructions.
6. Serve the pilaf with the pan-seared fish.
7. Squeeze a tablespoon of lemon juice over the fish and serve.
